title: Jeremiah 43
paragraphs: ¹ When Jeremiah had finished telling all the people everything the LORD their God had sent him to say — every single word — ² Azariah son of Hoshaiah, Johanan son of Kareah, and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, "You are lying! The LORD our God did not send you to say, 'Do not go to Egypt to settle there.' ³ It is Baruch son of Neriah who is inciting you against us, in order to hand us over to the Chaldeans so they can kill us or deport us to Babylon." ⁴ So Johanan son of Kareah, all the military commanders, and all the people refused to obey the LORD's command to stay in the land of Judah. ⁵ Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the military commanders led away the entire remnant of Judah who had returned from all the nations where they had been scattered to live in the land of Judah —

⁶ men, women, and children, the king's daughters, and everyone whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan, including Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah. ⁷ They went to Egypt in disobedience to the LORD and came as far as Tahpanhes. ⁸ Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes: ⁹ "Take some large stones and bury them in mortar at the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh's palace in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah. ¹⁰ Then say to them: This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says — I am going to send for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, my servant, and he will set his throne over these stones I have buried here. He will spread his royal canopy above them."

¹¹ When he comes, he will strike Egypt — delivering those destined for death to death, those destined for captivity to captivity, and those destined for the sword to the sword. ¹² I will set fire to the temples of Egypt's gods; he will burn them and take their gods captive. He will wrap Egypt around himself like a shepherd wraps his cloak, and he will leave that land unharmed. ¹³ He will demolish the sacred pillars of the temple of the sun in Egypt and burn down the temples of Egypt's gods.
